description.p: iptvXS is a modern IPTV viewer built with Qt6 and libmpv. It supports Xtream Codes and M3U playlist formats with features including an electronic programme guide (EPG), scheduled and live recording, Google Drive upload, favorites, and a theming system.

ul.li: Xtream Codes API and M3U playlist support
High-quality playback via libmpv with OpenGL rendering
Electronic Programme Guide (EPG) with XMLTV parser
Scheduled and live recording with ffmpeg
Google Drive upload for recordings
Favorites and channel search
Stream speed testing
Multiple themes (Midnight, Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Nord, Light)
System tray integration

description.p: Major UI polish, new features, and Steam Deck improvements.

ul.li: Rounded card corners with OpacityMask for poster images.
High-contrast theme: textOnAccent token across all views.
EPG: record button with confirmation popup and time padding.
EPG: vertical scrollbar and controller navigation.
Version check via gateway API with update notification.
Database statistics in Settings.
Logo cache management: auto-prune, size limit, clear button.
Draggable PIP window, VOD stops on navigate (no PIP for VOD).
Player: themed icons, smaller buttons, pulsing loading logo.
TopBar: live clock with blinking colon.
Speed test: internet-only, 60s default, favorites-first channels.
Favorites sorted to top of channel lists.
Steam Deck: external controller support, d-pad debounce, GameScope Google Drive auth.
Recording: EPG programme title capture, ffmpeg user-agent.
Home screen logo, server ordering (disabled at bottom).
Copyright headers on all source files.

description.p: Release focused on Steam Deck support, Flatpak reliability, and VOD browsing polish.

ul.li: Improved controller navigation for Steam Deck game mode.
Fixed EPG sync on Flatpak by normalizing XMLTV URLs.
Optimized VOD poster loading and cache behavior.
Fixed app data path handling on Linux.
